messages.content: what is the current status of brain

Current brain status (as of last update 2026-07-15):

**Foundation refactor: 2 of 4 modules done**
- ✅ Roles & Permissions — complete, NEG-proven
- ✅ Casino Settings — done, NEG-proven
- 🟡 User Management — UI built + data-wired, **security pass pending** (privacy rules, WF guards, NEG proof)
- 🔴 Fiscal Week Management — not started

**Critical app-wide gap (§0.5, live Bubble sweep 2026-07-15):** 0 of 46 live DTs meet Pattern A (company+property tenant isolation) outside R&P/Casino Settings. Notable holes:
- `06 Employee` — public-everyone with PII (passport, national ID, DOB)
- `11 Report` (13K records) — cross-tenant readable
- `29_1 Subtask` — public + API create/modify/delete exposed
- A candidate no-auth endpoint (`add_user_to_read_by_all_reports_copy`)
- 5 public file uploaders, no 2FA, no password policy app-wide

**Next queued (in order):** UM Pass-2 security → Pattern-A rollout packet (highest-risk DTs first) → Fiscal Week refactor → permission-model migration tail → app-wide audit logging.

**Open decisions blocking remediation:** Pattern-A rollout batching order; Company/Property table exceptions not yet formalized in decisions.md.

Full detail: `brain/STATUS.md` (product), `brain/database.md` + `brain/security.md` (as-built schema/security). Want me to check `brain/changelog.md` for anything newer than 07-15, or pull up a specific module's dimension table?

messages.content: give me list of all documentation and knowledge we have

Here's the full inventory of documentation and knowledge sources in the repo:

## brain/ — living infrastructure ledger (product knowledge base)
- **INDEX.md** — master map, read first
- **STATUS.md** — build status (what's done/next), just reviewed above
- **database.md** — every Data Type, as-built vs spec, tenancy compliance
- **option-sets.md** — every Option Set, as-built vs spec
- **security.md** — Pattern A privacy rules per DT
- **workflows.md** — every backend workflow/button
- **migrations.md** — migration plan, order, risks
- **security-test-checklist.md** — standing STRUCT/POS/NEG test gate
- **changelog.md** — append-only ingest history
- **design.md** — pointer to design/ system
- **modules/** (4 files) — technical ref + user manual for Casino Settings and Roles & Permissions (the only 2 fully-built modules)
- **digests/, engine/, qa/, reference/** — supporting subfolders (not yet summarized)
- **brain/buildprint/** (66 files) — full scraped Buildprint official manual: CLI usage, agents, automations, tests, plugins, components, plus `crs-brain-operations.md` (our operational guardrails), `PROMPT-STANDARD.md`, and `generated/` (past generated prompts)
- **brain/bubble/** (88 files) — complete official Bubble manual, verbatim, page by page
- **brain/bubble-forum/** (16 files) — curated community threads (WU optimization, privacy rules, multi-tenant patterns, bulk ops)
- **brain/bubble-performance/** — *The Ultimate Guide to Bubble Performance* (Petter Amlie, 227pp), split into 7 chapter files + source PDF

## Root-level authoritative docs
- **CLAUDE.md** — project conventions/rules (what you're reading now, essentially)
- **decisions.md** — append-only locked architecture/commercial decisions
- **README.md**

## design/
tokens.css (source of truth for colors), design.md (rules/reasoning), Styles.txt (plain reference), CRS_UI_Kit.html, logo assets

## specs/
CRS_Blueprint.html (main spec/roadmap doc), CRS_Blueprint_Source.html, Blueprint_Clear_Picture.html

## data/
CRS_Module_OptionSets.xlsx — authoritative module/section list (46 modules, 7 sections)

## pricing/
tiers.md — 3-tier pricing model

## prototypes/
buttons/, casino-settings/, studio-sample/ — HTML prototypes

## audits/
2026-04-27-property-field-audit.md

## qa-scratch/
Loop test artifacts (loop-c1..c4, loop-p3-c1/c2, loop-polish-c1/c2, rig) — QA scratch runs, not durable docs

## crs-brain/ (the second-brain tool itself, separate from product docs)
- BRAIN_APP_PROGRESS.md — the tool's own build log (not product status)
- README.md, USER-GUIDE.md, WISHLIST.md
- data/ — runtime state: progress.json (progress board), modules.json, plans.json, playbook.json, memory.json/md, chats/, audits/, screenshots/, various logs (action, ask, audit, error, usage)

If you want, I can drill into any specific folder (e.g. what's actually in `brain/digests/` or `brain/engine/`, which weren't in the INDEX.md map) or check `brain/changelog.md` for the latest ingest entries.
